title: Docker Compose 服务栈
markdown:
# Docker Compose 服务栈

## 概述

Docker Compose 是 Homelab 的核心编排工具——一个 YAML 文件定义所有服务、网络和存储卷，一条 `docker compose up -d` 命令让整个服务栈运行起来。对个人基础设施而言，Docker Compose 提供了声明式配置（可版本控制）、服务隔离（互不影响）、一键重建（换设备无痛迁移）和资源可控（CPU/内存限制）四大核心价值。本文提供一套经过生产验证的个人服务栈配置，从基础设施层（反向代理、认证）到应用层（文件存储、密码管理、照片库）。

## 核心概念

### 服务栈架构

```mermaid
graph TD
    Internet["互联网"] --> Traefik["Traefik 反向代理"]
    Traefik --> Auth["Authelia SSO"]
    Traefik --> Cloud["Nextcloud"]
    Traefik --> Vault["Vaultwarden"]
    Traefik --> Photos["Immich"]
    Traefik --> Docs["Paperless-ngx"]
    Traefik --> Auto["n8n 自动化"]
    Traefik --> Monitor["Uptime Kuma"]

    Cloud --> DB["PostgreSQL"]
    Photos --> DB
    Photos --> ML["机器学习模型"]
```

### 服务分层

| 层次     | 服务                         | 功能             |
| -------- | ---------------------------- | ---------------- |
| 基础设施 | Traefik, Authelia, WireGuard | 路由、认证、VPN  |
| 数据存储 | Nextcloud, Immich, Paperless | 文件、照片、文档 |
| 安全     | Vaultwarden, Pi-hole         | 密码、DNS 过滤   |
| 自动化   | n8n, Changedetection         | 工作流、网页监控 |
| 监控     | Uptime Kuma, Grafana         | 状态、指标       |

### Docker Compose 核心原则

- **每个服务一个目录**：`/opt/homelab/{service}/docker-compose.yml`
- **数据卷外挂**：用 bind mount 映射到主机目录，便于备份
- **网络隔离**：用 Docker network 隔离不同安全级别的服务
- **资源限制**：为每个容器设置内存和 CPU 上限
- **自动重启**：`restart: unless-stopped` 保证服务持久运行

## 实战指南

### 基础设施层：Traefik 反向代理

```yaml
# /opt/homelab/traefik/docker-compose.yml
services:
  traefik:
    image: traefik:v3.0
    container_name: traefik
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - '80:80'
      - '443:443'
    volumes:
      - /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock:ro
      - ./config/traefik.yml:/etc/traefik/traefik.yml:ro
      - ./config/dynamic:/etc/traefik/dynamic:ro
      - ./certs:/certs
      - ./logs:/logs
    networks:
      - proxy
    environment:
      - CF_DNS_API_TOKEN=${CF_DNS_API_TOKEN}
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 256M

networks:
  proxy:
    external: true
```

Traefik 静态配置：

```yaml
# /opt/homelab/traefik/config/traefik.yml
api:
  dashboard: true

entryPoints:
  web:
    address: ':80'
    http:
      redirections:
        entryPoint:
          to: websecure
  websecure:
    address: ':443'

certificatesResolvers:
  letsencrypt:
    acme:
      email: your@email.com
      storage: /certs/acme.json
      dnsChallenge:
        provider: cloudflare

providers:
  docker:
    exposedByDefault: false
    network: proxy
  file:
    directory: /etc/traefik/dynamic
```

### 安全层：Vaultwarden 密码管理

```yaml
# /opt/homelab/vaultwarden/docker-compose.yml
services:
  vaultwarden:
    image: vaultwarden/server:latest
    container_name: vaultwarden
    restart: unless-stopped
    volumes:
      - ./data:/data
    environment:
      - DOMAIN=https://vault.yourdomain.com
      - SIGNUPS_ALLOWED=false
      - ADMIN_TOKEN=${ADMIN_TOKEN}
      - SMTP_HOST=${SMTP_HOST}
      - SMTP_FROM=${SMTP_FROM}
      - SMTP_PORT=587
      - SMTP_SECURITY=starttls
      - SMTP_USERNAME=${SMTP_USER}
      - SMTP_PASSWORD=${SMTP_PASS}
    labels:
      - 'traefik.enable=true'
      - 'traefik.http.routers.vault.rule=Host(`vault.yourdomain.com`)'
      - 'traefik.http.routers.vault.tls.certresolver=letsencrypt'
      - 'traefik.http.services.vault.loadbalancer.server.port=80'
    networks:
      - proxy
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 256M

networks:
  proxy:
    external: true
```

### 数据层：Immich 照片管理

```yaml
# /opt/homelab/immich/docker-compose.yml
services:
  immich-server:
    image: ghcr.io/immich-app/immich-server:release
    container_name: immich-server
    restart: unless-stopped
    volumes:
      - /mnt/data/photos:/usr/src/app/upload
      - /etc/localtime:/etc/localtime:ro
    environment:
      - DB_HOSTNAME=immich-postgres
      - DB_USERNAME=postgres
      - DB_PASSWORD=${DB_PASSWORD}
      - DB_DATABASE_NAME=immich
      - REDIS_HOSTNAME=immich-redis
    depends_on:
      - immich-redis
      - immich-postgres
    labels:
      - 'traefik.enable=true'
      - 'traefik.http.routers.immich.rule=Host(`photos.yourdomain.com`)'
      - 'traefik.http.routers.immich.tls.certresolver=letsencrypt'
      - 'traefik.http.services.immich.loadbalancer.server.port=2283'
    networks:
      - proxy
      - immich-internal
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 2G

  immich-machine-learning:
    image: ghcr.io/immich-app/immich-machine-learning:release
    container_name: immich-ml
    restart: unless-stopped
    volumes:
      - ./model-cache:/cache
    networks:
      - immich-internal
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 4G

  immich-redis:
    image: redis:7-alpine
    container_name: immich-redis
    restart: unless-stopped
    networks:
      - immich-internal

  immich-postgres:
    image: tensorchord/pgvecto-rs:pg16-v0.2.1
    container_name: immich-postgres
    restart: unless-stopped
    volumes:
      - ./postgres:/var/lib/postgresql/data
    environment:
      - POSTGRES_PASSWORD=${DB_PASSWORD}
      - POSTGRES_USER=postgres
      - POSTGRES_DB=immich
    networks:
      - immich-internal

networks:
  proxy:
    external: true
  immich-internal:
    internal: true
```

### 文件层：Nextcloud

```yaml
# /opt/homelab/nextcloud/docker-compose.yml
services:
  nextcloud:
    image: nextcloud:29-apache
    container_name: nextcloud
    restart: unless-stopped
    volumes:
      - ./data:/var/www/html
      - /mnt/data/nextcloud:/var/www/html/data
    environment:
      - POSTGRES_HOST=nextcloud-db
      - POSTGRES_DB=nextcloud
      - POSTGRES_USER=nextcloud
      - POSTGRES_PASSWORD=${DB_PASSWORD}
      - NEXTCLOUD_TRUSTED_DOMAINS=cloud.yourdomain.com
      - OVERWRITEPROTOCOL=https
    depends_on:
      - nextcloud-db
    labels:
      - 'traefik.enable=true'
      - 'traefik.http.routers.nextcloud.rule=Host(`cloud.yourdomain.com`)'
      - 'traefik.http.routers.nextcloud.tls.certresolver=letsencrypt'
      - 'traefik.http.middlewares.nextcloud-headers.headers.stsSeconds=31536000'
    networks:
      - proxy
      - nextcloud-internal
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 1G

  nextcloud-db:
    image: postgres:16-alpine
    container_name: nextcloud-db
    restart: unless-stopped
    volumes:
      - ./postgres:/var/lib/postgresql/data
    environment:
      - POSTGRES_DB=nextcloud
      - POSTGRES_USER=nextcloud
      - POSTGRES_PASSWORD=${DB_PASSWORD}
    networks:
      - nextcloud-internal

networks:
  proxy:
    external: true
  nextcloud-internal:
    internal: true
```

## 最佳实践

### 环境变量管理

```bash
# /opt/homelab/.env（Git 忽略！）
CF_DNS_API_TOKEN=xxxxx
ADMIN_TOKEN=xxxxx
DB_PASSWORD=xxxxx
SMTP_HOST=smtp.example.com
SMTP_USER=noreply@yourdomain.com
SMTP_PASS=xxxxx
```

- **永远不要** 将密码硬编码在 YAML 中
- 使用 `.env` 文件或 Docker Secrets
- 备份 `.env` 到加密的离线存储

### 备份策略

```bash
#!/bin/bash
# /opt/homelab/scripts/backup.sh
BACKUP_DIR="/mnt/backup/homelab/$(date +%Y%m%d)"
mkdir -p "$BACKUP_DIR"

# 备份所有服务数据
for service in vaultwarden nextcloud immich paperless; do
  echo "Backing up $service..."
  cd /opt/homelab/$service
  docker compose stop
  tar -czf "$BACKUP_DIR/$service.tar.gz" ./data ./postgres 2>/dev/null
  docker compose start
done

# 保留最近 30 天
find /mnt/backup/homelab -maxdepth 1 -mtime +30 -exec rm -rf {} \;
```

### 资源监控

典型 Homelab 内存分配（16GB 设备）：

| 服务          | 内存限制 | 实际使用 |
| ------------- | -------- | -------- |
| Traefik       | 256 MB   | ~50 MB   |
| Vaultwarden   | 256 MB   | ~50 MB   |
| Nextcloud     | 1 GB     | ~400 MB  |
| Immich Server | 2 GB     | ~800 MB  |
| Immich ML     | 4 GB     | ~2 GB    |
| PostgreSQL(s) | 1 GB     | ~300 MB  |
| 其他服务      | 2 GB     | ~500 MB  |
| **系统保留**  | **4 GB** |          |

## 工具与生态

| 工具          | 类别     | 替代的云服务          |
| ------------- | -------- | --------------------- |
| Nextcloud     | 文件同步 | Google Drive, Dropbox |
| Vaultwarden   | 密码管理 | 1Password, LastPass   |
| Immich        | 照片管理 | Google Photos         |
| Paperless-ngx | 文档管理 | Evernote, 有道云      |
| FreshRSS      | RSS 阅读 | Feedly                |
| Actual Budget | 记账     | YNAB                  |
| Mealie        | 食谱管理 | 下厨房                |
| Gitea/Forgejo | 代码托管 | GitHub (私有仓库)     |

## 总结

Docker Compose 将"运维一套服务"变成了"维护一组 YAML 文件"。本文提供的服务栈配置已在真实环境中运行验证——你可以直接复制使用，也可以按需裁剪。核心原则记住三点：数据目录外挂（便于备份和迁移）、网络隔离（不同服务不互通）、资源限制（一个服务失控不拖垮全局）。从最刚需的服务开始（密码管理 + 文件同步），逐步扩展，比一次性搭建全套更可持续。
